text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Sweep Tosho—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey, Familiar!
Look at that!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking where Sweep Tosho was pointing,
I saw a claw machine filled with plushies
in the likeness of Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
When it comes down to it, Paka Petits
are essentially substitute dolls for Umamusume, right?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I wonder if you could take the fall
for the misfortunes heading my way instead?
Like homework or training, for example...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Alright, you go grab that one!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What do you mean? It's only natural!
It's a familiar's job to fetch whatever their master wants!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Well, but yeah... I suppose I can lend you
a helping hand. I'll cast a "success spell" for you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: There! This should do the trick!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Now, go, my familiar!
Go, go, gooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
